QuestInfo.name: Wolves Waiting for their Masters
QuestInfo.0: You must first go see Cassandra in order to collect an Aran Memory Fragment.
QuestInfo.1: You must look for the wolves that are waiting for their masters.
QuestInfo.2: When you approached the wolf, it jumped up and left an Aran Memory Fragment.
